concept: Leaving a place better than you found it (picking up litter, not disturbing wildlife)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character notices litter or a small mess in a natural space and cleans it up, leaving it better than they found it
exercise.reflection_prompt: Why does it matter to leave a place better, even if the mess wasn't the character's fault?
exercise.practice: Student names one place they could help take care of

assessment.success_marker: student names a real, specific place and action
